patches.name: Mario-style Child Character
patches.description: Mario character model with a smaller memory footprint. Fixes the v0.1.0 opening drawbridge cutscene freeze. Keeps the red cap, M badge, moustache, overalls and gloves. Uses Link's body animations, voice and abilities. Requires Ocarina of Time USA Rev B (NTSC 1.2). Separate browser saves.

patches.name: Mario + Expansion Memory (Experimental)
patches.description: Experimental Mario model with a 2 MiB scene-object bank using Expansion Pak RAM (normally about 1 MiB). Requires 8 MB RAM for the expanded bank; 4 MB systems retain vanilla allocation. Same Mario appearance as v0.1.1. Requires Ocarina of Time USA Rev B. Start a new game; incompatible with other versions' save states. Full playthrough unverified.

patches.name: Mario-style Child Character
patches.description: Original low-poly Mario-style mesh: red cap with M badge, round nose, moustache, blue overalls and white gloves. Uses child Link's body animations, voice, abilities and equipment; facial features are static. Requires Ocarina of Time USA Rev B (NTSC 1.2). Adult Link is unchanged. Separate browser saves.
patches.warning: Known opening drawbridge cutscene freeze. Use Mario v0.1.1 instead.

patches.name: Child Link Purple Tunic
patches.description: Child Link wears a purple Kokiri outfit. Requires Ocarina of Time USA Rev B (NTSC 1.2). Adult tunic colors are preserved. Modified games have separate browser saves.
